changes.content:
# House JSON Schema (draft 2020-12). Unconstrained patterns keep identifiers,
# dates and serialized scalar data exact-match without changing accepted values.
drawing:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    title:
      type: string
    updated_at:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
  required:
  - id
  - title
  - updated_at
  sections:
    Scene:
      kind: text

quickdraw_drawing:
  type: object
  properties:
    title: { type: string }
    content: { type: string }
    archived: { type: boolean }
    source_url: { type: string }
    source_revision: { type: string }
    author: { type: string }
    license: { type: string }
  required: [title, content, archived, source_url, source_revision, author, license]
